state_machine.description: Fresh FB instance before first scan; outputs and retained alarm history are at declared initial values.

transitions.actions: error=true; status=16#8001; hold hiAlarm/loAlarm at initial values
error=true; status=16#8002; hold hiAlarm/loAlarm at initial values

state_machine.description: Valid configuration; hysteresis alarm evaluation is enabled each scan.

transitions.actions: error=false; status=0; update hiAlarm/loAlarm using strict thresholds and retained history

state_machine.description: Invalid range state: loLevel >= hiLevel has highest priority.

transitions.actions: error=false; status=0; resume hysteresis alarm evaluation

state_machine.description: Invalid hysteresis-window state: hystWindow >= (hiLevel - loLevel), only when range is valid.

transitions.actions: error=false; status=0; resume hysteresis alarm evaluation

timer_plan.pt_durations: N/A - no timer function blocks are required
timer_plan.reset_conditions: N/A - no timer instances exist; fresh FB reset restores initial outputs and retained alarm history

priorities: Safety priority 1: diagnose loLevel >= hiLevel before any hysteresis-window check; if true, force error=true and status=16#8001.
Safety priority 2: diagnose hystWindow >= (hiLevel - loLevel) only when loLevel < hiLevel; if true, force error=true and status=16#8002.
Safety priority 3: during any invalid-configuration scan, do not update hiAlarm or loAlarm; preserve their previous observed values.
Safety priority 4: error and status are recalculated every scan; a valid configuration clears them to error=false and status=0.
Operational priority 1: when valid, evaluate high alarm with strict trigger Value > hiLevel and strict release Value < (hiLevel - hystWindow); equality retains previous hiAlarm.
Operational priority 2: when valid, evaluate low alarm with strict trigger Value < loLevel and strict release Value > (loLevel + hystWindow); equality retains previous loAlarm.
Numerical priority: REAL inputs and release/span arithmetic use IEEE-754 binary32 rounding; declared finite-domain assumptions apply.
Domain note: hystWindow is assumed nonnegative; negative hystWindow is outside the specified input domain.

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
scan_execution_order.actions: Sample Value, hiLevel, loLevel, and hystWindow once at scan start. Capture previous observed alarm outputs hiAlarmPrev and loAlarmPrev. Do not write outputs in this stage.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.actions: Evaluate badRange first: loLevel >= hiLevel. Only if badRange is false, evaluate badWindow: hystWindow >= (hiLevel - loLevel). Determine next state and set an alarm-update-enable flag. For badRange, set error=true, status=16#8001, and disable alarm updates. For badWindow without badRange, set error=true, status=16#8002, and disable alarm updates. For valid configuration, set error=false, status=0, and enable alarm updates. Do not modify alarms in this stage.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.actions: No timer FBs are required by this specification. This stage is explicitly a no-op; if future timers are added, their FB calls must remain unconditional and outside CASE/IF.

scan_execution_order.name: unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.actions: Write hiAlarm, loAlarm, error, and status exactly once. If alarm updates are enabled, use strict comparisons and retained history: set hiAlarm true when Value > hiLevel; clear hiAlarm when Value < (hiLevel - hystWindow); otherwise hold hiAlarmPrev. Set loAlarm true when Value < loLevel; clear loAlarm when Value > (loLevel + hystWindow); otherwise hold loAlarmPrev. If alarm updates are disabled, assign hiAlarm=hiAlarmPrev and loAlarm=loAlarmPrev. Finally update hiAlarmPrev and loAlarmPrev from the actual assigned outputs for the next scan.

formal_assertions.formula: G((loLevel >= hiLevel) -> ((hiAlarm <-> Y hiAlarm) & (loAlarm <-> Y loAlarm)))
G((!(loLevel >= hiLevel) & (hystWindow >= (hiLevel - loLevel))) -> ((hiAlarm <-> Y hiAlarm) & (loAlarm <-> Y loAlarm)))
G((!(loLevel >= hiLevel) & !(hystWindow >= (hiLevel - loLevel)) & (hystWindow >= 0) & ((hiLevel - hystWindow) <= Value) & (Value <= hiLevel)) -> (hiAlarm <-> Y hiAlarm))
G((!(loLevel >= hiLevel) & !(hystWindow >= (hiLevel - loLevel)) & (hystWindow >= 0) & (loLevel <= Value) & (Value <= (loLevel + hystWindow))) -> (loAlarm <-> Y loAlarm))
